description: NVIDIA documentation template library - pick, scaffold, apply, validate, report, and bootstrap full sites

skills.name: tpl-pick
skills.description: Recommend which template fits the user's goal. Returns one template, one format, and a ready-to-run `tpl-new-page` or `tpl-apply-template` command.

skills.name: tpl-new-page
skills.description: Scaffold one new page from a named template without silently overwriting authored content. Copies template, fills placeholders, strips author-only content.

skills.name: tpl-apply-template
skills.description: Patch an existing documentation page so it conforms to a named template while preserving verified content, frontmatter, links, anchors, and commands.

skills.name: tpl-lint
skills.description: Validate a page against a template schema. Reports missing sections, wrong order, orphan headings with fix recommendations.

skills.name: tpl-quality-report
skills.description: Generate a canonical HTML report for before/after updates or existing-page evaluations against a template.

skills.name: tpl-new-site
skills.description: Bootstrap a complete documentation site from the canonical IA. Generates the full directory tree with scaffolded pages.

skills.name: tpl-migrate-site
skills.description: Migrate an existing book toward the canonical IA: renames, splits, moves, indexes, flattens.
